concept.hr: Obećani i stvarni prostor: tanki bazen se puni pod svima
concept.en: Promised vs real space: the thin pool fills under everyone

summary.hr: Napravi tanke volumene, piši u njih i ostani bez mjesta: kad se bazen napuni, pisanje pada svima, i onima čiji datotečni sustav pokazuje slobodno.
summary.en: Create thin volumes, write, and run out: when the pool is full, writes fail for everyone, even where the filesystem shows free space.

concept.hr: Pisanje pada i volumenu čiji datotečni sustav pokazuje 40 GiB slobodno
concept.en: Writes fail even for a volume whose filesystem shows 40 GiB free

title.en: Deleted, not returned to the pool

concept.hr: Brisanje datoteka ne oslobađa bazen bez odbacivanja blokova
concept.en: Deleting files frees nothing in the pool without discard
